pr_title: *: support error handling for distributed adding index
pr_body:

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #43029, close #42436
Problem Summary:
This PR supports error handling for distributed adding index.
It 
1. modify the task tables in distribute framework, adding the error field.
2. adjust the framework to record the subtask's error.
3. do unsafeImport when finishing a partition when adding an index.
4. check the remote duplicate key if it's the unique index.

issue_context.title: The "add index" operation is block when dist-reorg is enabled
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->
```
set @@global.tidb_ddl_distribute_reorg = on;
create table t(a int, b int);
alter table t add index idx(a);
```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
This "add index" operation executes normally.

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
This operation is blocked.
The error log：` ["[ddl] runBackfillJobs error"] [error="[ddl:8247]Ingest failed: ingest engine not found"]`

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
master, after the PR: https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/42115
```
Release Version: v6.7.0-alpha-347-g3f8b0ccd81-dirty
Edition: Community
Git Commit Hash: 3f8b0ccd81374a27a466db2e934737503905b30c
Git Branch: master
UTC Build Time: 2023-03-21 07:22:27
```

review_comments: What is the usage of line 1764 to 1780 code block?
I think, so far we do not real run subtask, right? then line 1772 to 1779 can be removed?
Must call FinishImport to close engine correctly before scheduler finished one step of the global task, otherwise, the lightning is in open status.
Why not let MultiSchemaChange go with distributed execution? @tangenta we need support with several adding indexes in one statement.
I don't change the behavior. Which is the same as before.
If we have considered it in the test plan, supporting multi-schema change is fine.
Yes, it is better include all add index subjob could go distributed way.
